title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 007 ]

blocks.text: My belief is that all music has an expressive power, some more and some less,
but that all music has a certain meaning behind the notes.
That meaning constitutes what the piece is saying.
This whole problem can be stated quite simply by asking,
"Is there a meaning to music? " My answer to that would be,
"Yes." And "Can you state in so many
words what the meaning is?" My answer to that would be,

readingSentences.english: My belief is that all music has an expressive power, some more and some less, but that all music has a certain meaning behind the notes.
readingSentences.korean: 나는 모든 음악이 표현력을 가지고 있다고 믿으며, 정도의 차이는 있겠지만 모든 음악은 악보(음표) 뒤에 숨겨진 어떤 의미를 지니고 있다.

readingSentences.english: That meaning constitutes what the piece is saying.
readingSentences.korean: 그 의미가 바로 그 악곡이 말하고자 하는 바를 구성한다.

readingSentences.english: This whole problem can be stated quite simply by asking, "Is there a meaning to music?"
readingSentences.korean: 이 모든 문제는 "음악에 어떤 의미가 있는가?"라고 아주 단순하게 질문함으로써 설명될 수 있다.

readingSentences.english: My answer to that would be, "Yes."
readingSentences.korean: 그 질문에 대한 나의 대답은 "그렇다"일 것이다.

readingSentences.english: And "Can you state in so many words what the meaning is?"
readingSentences.korean: 그리고 "그 의미가 무엇인지 여러 말로 설명할 수 있는가?"

readingSentences.english: My answer to that would be, "No."
readingSentences.korean: 이 질문에 대한 나의 대답은 "아니다"일 것이다.
